reviews.text: Over all experience was a 10/10 very passionate and informative. I took my baby Maltipoo to get groomed here for the first time. They gave me exactly what I wanted, in a timely fashion. We will be regulars at this location

Had a blown out tire, was waiting for mechanic to bring me a new one. Parked in front of store out of panic. Rude owner didn’t let me explain why I parked there and kept interrupting telling me to park further next time. Bad owner. No compassion. Cared more for business than helping someone out.

Mari was incredibly helpful, kind, and knowledgeable. She made the whole visit enjoyable and went out of her way to make sure I found exactly what I needed !
Her friendly smile and positive attitude really stand out — customer service like that is hard to find these days. The store is lucky to have someone like Mari. I’ll definitely be coming back

BAD SERVICE!!!!!!! I went in to buy dog medication. When I found out that they sold me fish medication, I tried to return the item 2 minutes later and they would not accept it. They claim to be experts in the field, talk down on other feed stores but are the absolute worst. They are not interested in the customer. The lady helping me is a short Hispanic lady.

Be careful on what they recommend to your pets. They are not licensed or experts.

Do NOT BUY HERE!!!!
I just love the service here no more high vet bills they are the best anything you need the have and just love the workers they always so nice thank u for ur services
